truth_source: Maintainer message, 2026-09-23; eight visits from the first visit
throw_window_source: Visual camera-1 review at 0.5-second intervals (visit 4 at 1-second intervals): dividers fall before the next visible dart arrives. These are attribution windows, not precise impact timestamps. First publication in each window is assessed; subsequent publications are extra events, never shifted onto a later throw or selected by matching its score. Delayed publications spanning a divider require further review.
window_source: Independent visual review of camera 1, sampled every 3 seconds; boundaries lie in empty-board gaps between visits. These are visit windows, not independently annotated individual arrival times.
coverage_note: The recording starts with a dart already present. The frozen-start replay replaces 0-9 seconds with this recording's empty frame at 9 seconds and evaluates visits 2-8 only. Visit 1 is excluded from replay coverage, not counted as a detector miss. Original timestamps from 9 seconds onward are preserved.
